public.text: “Public Health Surveillance Platform” is broad and may include case reporting, event-based surveillance, laboratory surveillance, contact management, analytics, alerts, and response coordination. Some of these are programme-specific or operational.
public.suggestedRevision: Define the shared surveillance capabilities included in DPI-H and distinguish them from disease-specific workflows, outbreak-management tools, laboratory systems, and emergency-response applications.
